verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents job/workflow APIs for tracking processing jobs, dedicated VPC instances for scale, and a 10,000 free-page tier, implying batch/production-scale capability, but no evidence pack item specifies actual rate limits, throughput numbers, or SLAs for millions of pages. missing for 10: documented rate limits (requests/sec or pages/hour), throughput benchmarks at millions-of-pages scale, and any independent corroboration of predictable performance at that volume.
